purpose: Define the response-blind dataset digest used for the prospective 250-species cap and deterministic train/evaluation split without reading nucleotide characters.
digest_algorithm: SHA256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',',':')

payload.selected_panel_entries: sorted by canonical species; each entry contains canonical species, taxonomy fields, raw genes.txt gene, raw dir, SHA256 of the ordered FASTA header strings only, SHA256 of occurrences.txt raw bytes, and sorted exact usable latitude-longitude pairs
payload.sequence_characters: MUST NOT be read, hashed, counted, validated, or included

panel_cap_key: SHA256('<dataset_digest>|<canonical species>') ascending; retain first 250 if eligible species exceed 250
split_key: SHA256('<dataset_digest>|split|<canonical species>') ascending; lower floor(n/2) species are training and the remainder evaluation
tie_break: hex digest lexicographic order, then canonical species lexicographic order if ever required
